description:
The Huffy Glimmer 12" Kids Bike is designed to make early riding adventures exciting and confidence-building. With playful style and fun accessories, this bike is perfect for young riders learning to pedal while enjoying neighborhood rides and driveway fun.
The Glimmer features Huffy’s EZ Build system, designed to make bike assembly faster and simpler. With a streamlined setup process and fewer steps, parents can spend less time assembling and more time watching their rider enjoy every new adventure.
Training wheels help young riders build balance and confidence as they learn to ride. A coaster brake allows easy pedal-back stopping, while the front sidepull caliper brake introduces responsive hand-brake control as skills grow. Wide tires, comfortable grips, and fun accessories like a handlebar bag and streamers make every ride steady, stylish, and fun.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for simple pedal-back stopping plus a front sidepull caliper brake for added control as riding skills grow.
Sidepull caliper hand brake and rear coaster brake
